'''Venich''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was at one point present in the cantina on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
